representation_plans.learner_operation: Compare plate overlap area and plate separation before applying C = epsilon A divided by d.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text specification states overlap area, separation, and intervening material for each capacitor without computing the comparison.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Select Q = CV and an equivalent energy expression based on the quantities fixed or supplied.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text equation set lists Q = CV and the three equivalent stored-energy forms with all variables named.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Identify shared nodes for parallel branches, single-path ordering for series branches, and the battery connection state before predicting a dielectric effect.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text circuit description names each capacitor’s endpoint nodes, dielectric state, and whether the battery remains connected.
